AUTHZ_FORBIDDEN.ui_action: Show permission error; do not retry.

AUTH_CALLER_CONTEXT_INVALID.ui_action: Report a server integration authentication failure; repair the caller signer, not user login.

AUTH_CALLER_CONTEXT_MISSING.ui_action: Report a server integration authentication failure; repair the caller signer, not user login.

AUTH_CSRF_REJECTED.ui_action: Correct the same-origin request configuration or reload; do not automatically retry.

AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS.ui_action: Sign in again; refresh only AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED once.

AUTH_RATE_LIMITED.ui_action: Wait for the registration cooldown; do not retry or prompt for login automatically.

AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED.ui_action: Refresh once under the browser coordinator, then retry once; otherwise sign in.

AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID.ui_action: Show sign-in; do not automatically refresh a revoked or invalid session.

AUTH_TOKEN_MISSING.ui_action: Show sign-in; do not automatically refresh.

CONFLICT_ACTIVE_RELEASE.ui_action: Reload current state and ask for a new action; do not automatically retry.

CONFLICT_EMAIL_EXISTS.ui_action: Choose another email or sign in to the existing account.

CONFLICT_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY.ui_action: Create a new key for a new action; retry an existing key only with its original payload.
